Access to area islands including Star Island
Experienced Captain Jack Farrell with 30 years boating experience

blurb: Guests can rent the entire boat for private charters with custom itineraries including sightseeing, wildlife watching, and special events. The Star Island Mail Boat excursion offers individual tickets on scheduled mail and freight runs to Star Island. Burials at sea services are provided for scattering cremated remains offshore with memorial options.
extraNote: Full refund with at least 48 hours notice; 50% refund with 24 hours written notice; no refunds less than 24 hours · Captain may cancel due to weather; reschedule or full refund offered · Tipping welcomed but not required · Kittery Point Town Dock located behind the Pepperrell Cove Restaurant complex at 88 Pepperrell Road, Maine Route 103, Kittery Point, Maine · Three season service available; Star Island Mail Boat runs June 22 through Labor Day
